## Summary

```text
Reviewed merge to main → Quality → stage exact tested commit → smoke checks → promote → public smoke checks
```

The deployment guard accepts a production environment with a main-only branch policy and no required reviewer. After merge, clear **Required reviewers** in the [GitHub production environment](https://github.com/lhajoosten/lucjoosten.nl/settings/environments), as described in the [runbook](docs/operations/production-deployment.md#enable-automatic-deployments).

## Verification

- Before the guard change, `node scripts/deployment/deployment.test.mjs` rejected the main-only fixture because it had no required reviewers. The updated fixture now passes and the wildcard branch policy fixture still fails the guard.
- `pnpm --config.verifyDepsBeforeRun=false check` passed formatting, lint, type checking, 21 unit tests and 25 deployment tests.
- `pnpm --config.verifyDepsBeforeRun=false build` passed and generated four pages and the 404 document.
- `actionlint -shellcheck= .github/workflows/production.yml` and `git diff --check` passed.
- GitHub currently has one production branch rule for `main`, a required reviewer rule and zero waiting Production runs. Live automatic deployment can be verified after cutover.

## Merge Danger

**Door** Two-way. Restoring the reviewer rule pauses future Production jobs at the environment.

**Blast radius** Production deployments.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: internal
summary: Allow the Production workflow to run without a required environment reviewer.
impact: Reviewed changes reaching main can deploy automatically after Quality and staged smoke checks pass.
required_action: Clear Required reviewers on the production environment after merging the workflow change.
```

## Summary

Adopt the finalized v0.1.0 recovery at `eb4e511`, the landing of #15. Pin the exact history of the rejected proposal in #12. Require a generated proposal marker tied to the current base, exact head parents, matching PR marker, and configured Release Log bot inside the existing required Quality check.

## Verification

- The new check accepts the original generated head `329dd46` and rejects the manually updated head `e00761a` that caused the [rolling-release failure](https://github.com/lhajoosten/lucjoosten.nl/actions/runs/44845860118).
- Regression coverage exercises initial and refreshed heads, stale proposals, manual merges, mismatched markers, and unexpected authors or repositories.
- A read-only replay of #16 with the pinned v0.5.0 source, real Git and GitHub evidence, and a simulated lightweight v0.1.0 tag selected `eb4e511` and reported `no-release`.
- `pnpm check`, `pnpm build`, and actionlint for both workflows passed.

## Merge Danger

Two-way. After owner approval, the lightweight `v0.1.0` tag must point to `eb4e5115ebae8433b04fe0c74fc6e92f48a6b72f` before merging this PR. The next roll can then verify and resume from that boundary.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: internal
summary: Adopt the reviewed v0.1.0 release and verify proposal heads before merge.
impact: Rolling releases resume from the finalized changelog, and Quality blocks manual updates to generated release branches.
required_action: null
```

## Summary

```text
Homepage → four selected projects
Projects index → six projects
  ├─ Release Log → existing case study
  ├─ Upkeep → local discovery and planned integration
  └─ lucjoosten.nl → static build and browser navigation
```

Refs #19. ReviewBot and kube-lab use the goals described in the issue. The owner confirmed kube-lab is private and approved this repository’s README and implementation as evidence for the portfolio case study. Release Log’s AI-written notes remain described as planned, pending reviewed evidence of implementation.

## Evidence

- **Before** The index listed four projects and linked to one case study.
- **After** `pnpm check`, `pnpm build` and `pnpm test:e2e --workers=4` passed. All 46 browser tests passed.
- The Vercel preview for `12e8fe6` returned HTTP 200 with expected titles and canonical URLs for the index and all three case studies. An unknown project URL returned the custom HTTP 404 page with noindex. The hosted index shows kube-lab as private.

## Merge Danger

**Door** Two-way. A revert restores the prior index and route list.

**Blast radius** Portfolio copy, case-study layout and static project routing.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: users
summary: Expand the project portfolio with six projects and two new case studies.
impact: Visitors can browse a broader project index and read case studies on Upkeep and lucjoosten.nl.
required_action: null
```

```text
PR opened or edited
  → Validate title, release context and commits with Release Log v0.5.1
  → Report the metadata check before merge
```

## Evidence

- **Before** [PR #20](https://github.com/lhajoosten/lucjoosten.nl/pull/20) merged with missing release metadata and the roll failed.
- **After merge** Exercise the check on a follow-up PR with invalid and corrected metadata, then require `metadata` on `main`. The workflow runs from the base branch and cannot validate its own introduction.

## Merge Danger

**Door** Two-way. The workflow and required check can be removed if the rollout needs to be reverted.

**Blast radius** PR checks targeting `main`. The job uses read-only permissions and checks out the pinned validator from Release Log.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: internal
summary: Check website PR release metadata before merge.
impact: Surface release-blocking title, context and commit errors during PR review.
required_action: null
```

pullRequests.body:
## Summary

```text
Quality succeeds on main
  → preflight checks the tested SHA and production settings
  → deploy enters the production queue
  → stage, smoke-test, recheck main, promote and verify
```

Preflight fails immediately if GitHub reports a deployment gate. GitHub replaces the pending deploy job when another eligible job arrives and lets the active deploy job finish.

## Evidence

- Before. [Production #15](https://github.com/lhajoosten/lucjoosten.nl/actions/runs/44894580767) was waiting for a reviewer, and [#16](https://github.com/lhajoosten/lucjoosten.nl/actions/runs/44895572276) was pending behind it. GitHub reported a required reviewer on the production environment. Both new deployment-gate tests failed before the fix.
- After. `pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false check`, `pnpm --config.verify-deps-before-run=false build` and `git diff --check` passed. Live cutover and browser tests were not run locally.

## Merge Danger

**Door** Two-way workflow and settings change.

**Blast radius** Production deployments.

After merge, cancel legacy Production runs waiting for review or pending behind them. Let any active promotion finish. Clear **Required reviewers** on the GitHub **production** environment, retain the exact `main` branch policy and environment secrets, then rerun Quality on current main. The [operations guide](docs/operations/production-deployment.md#enable-automatic-deployments) has the full sequence.

## Release context

```release-log
version: 1
audience: internal
summary: Validate production deployment settings before entering the deploy queue.
impact: Reviewed changes can deploy automatically after successful Quality checks once the GitHub reviewer rule is cleared.
required_action: Cancel legacy waiting Production runs, clear Required reviewers on the production environment and rerun Quality on current main.
```
